node: Healthcare and nursing licensure education capacity: ABSN, OTA, simulation technology, VR training, prerequisites, and clinical-placement support
summary: Layer 1B expansion found a small universe of US-listed names tied to healthcare-licensure education capacity, with the strongest underfollowed chokepoint signal in clinical-placement software and healthcare workforce-learning infrastructure. HealthStream appears to be the cleanest small-cap supplier candidate after acquiring clinical-rotation management assets in 2024. Grand Canyon Education is a mid-cap program-services operator with explicit ABSN/OTA, simulation, VR, and prerequisite-strategy exposure through university partners. Adtalem is a reference capacity operator because Chamberlain is a large nursing-school platform with clinical hub expansion, but it is less of a hidden supplier. Strategic Education is a weaker second-order hypothesis via Sophia Learning prerequisites and employer education-benefits infrastructure, requiring proof of nursing/allied-health adoption before promotion.
